content: Roughness of a discrete curve beta_k(t) can be measured by its total squared second difference: sum_{j=1}^{m-2} (beta[j+1] - 2*beta[j] + beta[j-1])^2. This is a finite difference approximation to the integrated squared second derivative (curvature). Larger kernel bandwidth → more smoothing → smaller roughness metric. Test: compute roughness for bandwidths h1 < h2 → roughness(h2) < roughness(h1). This is the standard monotone-smoothness check in nonparametric regression.
